# Trimble Connect Model API

- **Definition:** [model@v1](https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/Trimble-Connect/model/v1), status ga. Security schemes: Bearer.
- **Developer Portal:** https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect/reference/openapi/model/.
- **Regions:** ap, ap-au, eu, eu-gb, us.
- **Calling from the MCP:** pass the operation `key` (`model:METHOD path`) to `trimble_api_read` (read) or `trimble_api_plan` (plan), with `product: "trimble-connect"`. Path, query and header parameters are validated against this catalogue.

## Batch Operations

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/models/{modelId}/batch-get` | `plan` | Returns resources (entities and property set definitions) by a list of identifiers. | modelId* (path); versionId (query); include (query); fields (query); body: application/json |
